profile_text.body:
Blender Foundation is a non-profit, open-source organization that develops and maintains Blender, a free 3D creation suite available to anyone. The software covers a wide range of production tasks including rendering, camera and object tracking, rigging, animation, visual effects, and 2D drawing directly within a 3D viewport. Blender's interface is controlled via Python, and it supports a large ecosystem of community-built add-ons accessible through its Python API. The foundation describes Blender as used in short films, advertisements, TV series, and feature films, and notes that VFX professionals have called its tracking tools "probably the best tracker in the market." Blender is a member of ASWF, Khronos, the Linux Foundation, and OIN, and receives hardware support from AMD, Apple, Intel, NVIDIA, and Qualcomm.

On the AI side, the site tracks Blender AI Add-ons as a category of third-party plugins that bring AI capabilities into the 3D creation workflow. These add-ons are described as open-source and locally processed, with model provenance varying by individual plugin. Upcoming development noted on the site includes a Cycles Texture Cache feature in Blender 5.2 LTS aimed at making memory use more efficient when rendering scenes with many image textures. No litigation, patent filings, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the foundation in the held facts.
